author: National Geographic
description:
Situated on an isthmus between Lakes Mendota and Monona, Madison, Wisconsin, is a haven for lakeside adventures. The state's capital is compact enough to explore on foot or by bike, with more than 200 miles (322 kilometers) of hiking trails and bikeways connecting leafy neighborhoods, beaches, and some 300 parks.
